The coefficients are `(lambda₀ - Lambda) * 1 * 1`. Their Dirichlet series
is the pole-cleared zeta-square expression on its absolute half-plane.

namespace RHTower.WeilSingularArithmetic

open GaussZeroSum

def sourceSquareCoeff (lam : ℕ → ℝ) : ℕ → ℂ :=
  LSeries.convolution (LSeries.convolution
    (WeilHerglotz.lamC lam - fun n => (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℂ)) 1) 1

@[simp] theorem sourceSquareCoeff_zero (lam : ℕ → ℝ) : sourceSquareCoeff lam 0 = 0 := by
  simp [sourceSquareCoeff, LSeries.convolution_def]

theorem sourceSquareCoeff_summable {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : LSeriesSummable (sourceSquareCoeff lam) s := by
  have hlam : LSeriesSummable (WeilHerglotz.lamC lam) s := WeilHerglotz.summable_term_lamC hW hs
  exact ((hlam.sub
    (ArithmeticFunction.LSeriesSummable_vonMangoldt hs)).convolution
      (LSeriesSummable_one_iff.mpr hs)).convolution (LSeriesSummable_one_iff.mpr hs)

theorem LSeries_sourceSquareCoeff {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : LSeries (sourceSquareCoeff lam) s = sourceZetaSquare hW s := by
  have hlam : LSeriesSummable (WeilHerglotz.lamC lam) s := WeilHerglotz.summable_term_lamC hW hs
  have hΛ := ArithmeticFunction.LSeriesSummable_vonMangoldt hs
  have h1 := LSeriesSummable_one_iff.mpr hs
  unfold sourceSquareCoeff
  rw [LSeries_convolution' ((hlam.sub hΛ).convolution h1) h1,
    LSeries_convolution' (hlam.sub hΛ) h1, LSeries_sub hlam hΛ,
    LSeries_one_eq_riemannZeta hs,
    ArithmeticFunction.LSeries_vonMangoldt_eq_deriv_riemannZeta_div hs]
  have hζ : riemannZeta s ≠ 0 := riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re hs
  have hD : zetaArchimedeanDatum s + 1 / (s - 1) - WeilSpectral.weilContinuation hW s =
      LSeries (WeilHerglotz.lamC lam) s := by
    rw [WeilSpectral.weilContinuation_eq hW hs, WeilHerglotz.weilFunction,
      zetaArchimedeanDatum]
    ring
  unfold sourceZetaSquare
  rw [hD]
  field_simp
  ring

theorem sourceZetaPairing_leftDual {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam) (t : ℝ) :
    sourceZetaPairing hW (1 - leftPt t) =
      zetaChi (leftPt t) * LSeries (sourceSquareCoeff lam) (1 - leftPt t) := by
  rw [LSeries_sourceSquareCoeff hW (by simp [leftPt]; norm_num)]
  unfold sourceZetaPairing sourceZetaSquare
  rw [sub_sub_cancel, riemannZeta_eq_of_mem_leftStrip (leftPt_mem_leftStrip t)]
  ring

theorem gaussWeight_one_sub (T : ℝ) (s : ℂ) : gaussWeight T (1 - s) = gaussWeight T s := by
  unfold gaussWeight
  congr 1
  ring

/-- Exact signed coefficient extraction from the actual right-line source contour. -/
theorem integral_sourceZetaPairing_eq_kernelSum {lam : ℕ → ℝ} (hW : WeilPositiveFull lam)
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 1 ≤ T) :
    (∫ t : ℝ, sourceZetaPairing hW ((3 / 2 : ℂ) + t * I) *
      gaussWeight T ((3 / 2 : ℂ) + t * I)) =
      2 * Real.pi * ∑' n : ℕ, sourceSquareCoeff lam n * leftKernel T n := by
  have hi := integral_zetaChi_mul_LSeries
    (sourceSquareCoeff_summable hW (s := ((3 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) (by norm_num))
    hT (r := 1) (by norm_num)
  simp only [Complex.ofReal_one, Complex.one_cpow, one_mul, mul_one] at hi
  have he (t : ℝ) : sourceZetaPairing hW ((3 / 2 : ℂ) + ((-t : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) *
      gaussWeight T ((3 / 2 : ℂ) + ((-t : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) =
      zetaChi (leftPt t) * LSeries (sourceSquareCoeff lam) (1 - leftPt t) *
        gaussWeight T (leftPt t) := by
    have hp : (3 / 2 : ℂ) + ((-t : ℝ) : ℂ) * I = 1 - leftPt t := by
      simp only [leftPt, Complex.ofReal_neg]
      ring
    rw [hp, sourceZetaPairing_leftDual hW, gaussWeight_one_sub]
  have hneg := integral_neg_eq_self (fun t : ℝ => sourceZetaPairing hW ((3 / 2 : ℂ) + t * I) *
    gaussWeight T ((3 / 2 : ℂ) + t * I))
  rw [← hneg]
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [hi]
  congr 1
  apply tsum_congr
  intro n
  split_ifs with hn
  · simp [hn]
  · rfl

/-!
# Completed-error balance on canonical Gamma--Slepian heads

This module gives a regularity-free normal form for the Route O sign problem.  For an actual
physical aperture head `f`, every finite von Mangoldt translation is split into its scalar mass
and the nonnegative squared translation loss

`J_prime(f) = sum_n Lambda(n) / sqrt(n) * ||U_(log n) f - f||^2`.

The polar compression is retained as the signed autocorrelation debt

`J_polar(f) = 8 sinh(a) ||f||^2 - re <Polar f, f>`.

The endpoint scalar left by the prime--polar cancellation is exactly twice the completed critical
Mellin error `D(2a)`.  Consequently the literal restricted-Weil source quadratic is exactly

`GammaFormEnergy + (gammaScalar + 2 D(2a)) ||f||^2 + J_prime(f) - J_polar(f)`.

No derivative or smoothness of the actual head autocorrelation is used.  Specializing to the
canonical exact-ground Gamma--Slepian heads identifies literal reverse-prime control with
nonnegativity of this signed balance, without a common-clock or prolate substitution.
-/

open scoped ENNReal InnerProduct InnerProductSpace BigOperators

namespace RHTower

def ccmPrimeTranslationDefectEnergy
    (a : SuzukiPositiveAperture) (f : suzukiApertureHilbert a) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (Nat.floor (Real.exp (2 * a.1))),
    criticalMellinAtomWeight n *
      ‖logTranslationCLM (Real.log n) f.1 - f.1‖ ^ 2

theorem logTranslation_norm (h : ℝ) (f : SoninL2) :
    ‖logTranslationCLM h f‖ = ‖f‖ := by
  exact (MellinL2.additiveTranslationUnitary h).norm_map f

theorem logTranslation_defect_eq
    (h : ℝ) (f : SoninL2) :
    ‖logTranslationCLM h f - f‖ ^ 2 =
      2 * ‖f‖ ^ 2 -
        (inner ℂ (logTranslationCLM h f) f +
          inner ℂ (logTranslationCLM (-h) f) f).re := by
  rw [norm_sub_sq (𝕜 := ℂ), logTranslation_norm]
  simp only [RCLike.re_to_complex]
  have hadj : inner ℂ (logTranslationCLM (-h) f) f =
      inner ℂ f (logTranslationCLM h f) := by
    rw [inner_logTranslationCLM (-h)]
    simp
  rw [hadj]
  have hre : (inner ℂ f (logTranslationCLM h f)).re =
      (inner ℂ (logTranslationCLM h f) f).re := by
    simpa using inner_re_symm (𝕜 := ℂ) f (logTranslationCLM h f)
  simp only [Complex.add_re, hre]
  ring_nf

theorem criticalMellinAtomWeight_eq_div_sqrt
    (n : ℕ) :
    criticalMellinAtomWeight n =
      ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n / Real.sqrt n := by
  unfold criticalMellinAtomWeight
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := by positivity
  rw [show (-1 / 2 : ℝ) = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) by ring, Real.rpow_neg hn0,
    ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  ring

theorem ccmPrimeTranslationDefectEnergy_nonneg
    (a : SuzukiPositiveAperture) (f : suzukiApertureHilbert a) :
    0 ≤ ccmPrimeTranslationDefectEnergy a f := by
  unfold ccmPrimeTranslationDefectEnergy
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun n hn => mul_nonneg
    (by
      rw [criticalMellinAtomWeight_eq_div_sqrt n]
      exact div_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
    (sq_nonneg _)

theorem re_inner_ccmPrimeTransportOperator_eq_defect
    (a : SuzukiPositiveAperture) (n : ℕ)
    (f : suzukiApertureHilbert a) :
    (inner ℂ (ccmPrimeTransportOperator a n f) f).re =
      2 / Real.sqrt n * ‖f‖ ^ 2 -
        (1 / Real.sqrt n) *
          ‖logTranslationCLM (Real.log n) f.1 - f.1‖ ^ 2 := by
  rw [inner_ccmPrimeTransportOperator]
  simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
    zero_mul, sub_zero, Complex.add_re]
  rw [logTranslation_defect_eq]
  simp only [Submodule.coe_norm, Complex.add_re]
  ring

theorem re_inner_ccmFinitePrimeOperator_eq_mass_sub_defect
    (a : SuzukiPositiveAperture) (f : suzukiApertureHilbert a) :
    (inner ℂ (ccmFinitePrimeOperator a f) f).re =
      2 * criticalMellinPrimeMass (2 * a.1) * ‖f‖ ^ 2 -
        ccmPrimeTranslationDefectEnergy a f := by
  rw [inner_ccmFinitePrimeOperator]
  rw [Complex.re_sum]
  simp_rw [Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero]
  have hterm : ∀ n ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (Nat.floor (Real.exp (2 * a.1))),
      (inner ℂ (ccmPrimeTransportOperator a n f) f).re =
        2 / Real.sqrt n * ‖f‖ ^ 2 -
          (1 / Real.sqrt n) *
            ‖logTranslationCLM (Real.log n) f.1 - f.1‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro n hn
    exact re_inner_ccmPrimeTransportOperator_eq_defect a n f
  rw [show (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (Nat.floor (Real.exp (2 * a.1))),
      ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n *
        (inner ℂ (ccmPrimeTransportOperator a n f) f).re) =
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (Nat.floor (Real.exp (2 * a.1))),
        ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n *
          (2 / Real.sqrt n * ‖f‖ ^ 2 -
            (1 / Real.sqrt n) *
              ‖logTranslationCLM (Real.log n) f.1 - f.1‖ ^ 2) by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro n hn
    rw [hterm n hn]]

/-!
# Uniform square-root scale for the actual Weil pole diagonal

The exact diagonal cancellation, uniform boundary mass, elementary Mertens,
and Chebyshev bounds give an aperture-independent multiple of `exp(a)`.
Consequently positive literal pole compression would give that same scale
for the integrated Chebyshev deficit. The source sign remains an antecedent.
-/

open Complex MeasureTheory Set
open scoped InnerProduct
noncomputable section
namespace RHTower

/-- One explicit aperture-independent bound for the normalized actual pole diagonal. -/
def ccmWeilPoleUniformDiagonalBound : ℝ :=
  |-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant-Real.log (2*Real.pi)|+
    (2*Real.log 2+Real.pi+1)+4+2*(Real.log 4+5)+2*(Real.log 4+4)

theorem ccmWeilPoleUniformDiagonalBound_pos : 0<ccmWeilPoleUniformDiagonalBound := by
  unfold ccmWeilPoleUniformDiagonalBound
  positivity

/-- The full pole self energy has the exact square-root scale at every positive
aperture, unconditionally and with every prime-power term retained. -/
theorem abs_ccmWeilPoleDiagonal_le (a : SuzukiPositiveAperture) :
    |ccmWeilPoleDiagonal a| ≤ ccmWeilPoleUniformDiagonalBound*Real.exp a.1 := by
  have ha := a.property
  have he := Real.exp_pos a.1
  have hm := Real.exp_pos (-a.1)
  have he1 : 1≤Real.exp a.1 := Real.one_le_exp ha.le
  have hm1 : Real.exp (-a.1)≤1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by linarith)
  have hinv : Real.exp a.1*Real.exp (-a.1)=1 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add,add_neg_cancel,Real.exp_zero]
  have hae : a.1≤Real.exp a.1 := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp a.1]
  have ham : a.1*Real.exp (-a.1)≤1 := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hae hm.le
    rwa [hinv] at hh
  have hterm : |(1-2*a.1)*Real.exp (-a.1)|≤3*Real.exp a.1 := by
    apply abs_le.mpr
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  have hN0 : 0≤2*Real.sinh a.1 := by
    rw [Real.sinh_eq]
    linarith
  have hN : 2*Real.sinh a.1≤Real.exp a.1 := by
    rw [Real.sinh_eq]
    linarith
  have hk : |(-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant-Real.log (2*Real.pi))*(2*Real.sinh a.1)| ≤
      |-Real.eulerMascheroniConstant-Real.log (2*Real.pi)| *Real.exp a.1 := by
    rw [abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg hN0]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hN (abs_nonneg _)
  have hEM := abs_ccmReciprocalMangoldtError_le (show 0≤2*a.1 by linarith)
  have hM : |2*Real.exp a.1*ccmReciprocalMangoldtError (2*a.1)|≤
      2*Real.exp a.1*(Real.log 4+5) := by
    rw [abs_mul,abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0<2*Real.exp a.1)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hEM (by positivity)
  have hP0 : 0≤2*Real.exp (-a.1)*Chebyshev.psi (Real.exp (2*a.1)) := by
    exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) (Chebyshev.psi_nonneg _)
  have hP : 2*Real.exp (-a.1)*Chebyshev.psi (Real.exp (2*a.1)) ≤
      2*(Real.log 4+4)*Real.exp a.1 := by
    have hp := Chebyshev.psi_le_const_mul_self (Real.exp_pos (2*a.1)).le
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (show 0≤2*Real.exp (-a.1) by positivity)
    have heq : Real.exp (-a.1)*Real.exp (2*a.1)=Real.exp a.1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring
    calc
      _ ≤ 2*Real.exp (-a.1)*((Real.log 4+4)*Real.exp (2*a.1)) := hh
      _ = _ := by rw [show 2*Real.exp (-a.1)*((Real.log 4+4)*Real.exp (2*a.1)) =
        2*(Real.log 4+4)*(Real.exp (-a.1)*Real.exp (2*a.1)) by ring,heq]
  have hB0 := (ccmGammaPoleBoundaryMass_nonneg a).2
  have hB := ccmGammaPoleSelfBoundaryMass_le a
  obtain ⟨hkL,hkR⟩ := abs_le.mp hk
  obtain ⟨hML,hMR⟩ := abs_le.mp hM
  obtain ⟨htL,htR⟩ := abs_le.mp hterm
  rw [ccmWeilPoleDiagonal_eq_error,ccmWeilPoleUniformDiagonalBound]
  apply abs_le.mpr
  constructor <;> nlinarith [Real.log_nonneg (show (1:ℝ)≤4 by norm_num),

/-!
# Removing primes destroys Weil positivity

For a set `R` of primes, let `Λ_R(n) = Λ(n)` unless `n` is a power of a prime in `R`, and
`Λ_R(n) = 0` otherwise: the von Mangoldt function of `ζ(s) ∏_{p ∈ R}(1 - p^{-s})`.  Removing finitely
many Euler factors does not move the zeros of `ζ` in the critical strip (the new zeros lie on
`Re s = 0`), but it destroys Weil positivity for the archimedean datum of `ζ`, unconditionally:
`Λ_R ≤ Λ`, and a full-cone Weil-positive minorant of `Λ` equals `Λ`
(`eq_vonMangoldt_of_weilPositiveFull_of_le`).
-/

namespace RHTower
namespace RemovedPrimes

open ArithmeticFunction

/-- The von Mangoldt function with the powers of the primes in `R` removed. -/
noncomputable def vonMangoldtWithout (R : Set ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  Set.indicator {m | ¬ ∃ p ∈ R, ∃ k, m = p ^ k} (fun m => (vonMangoldt m : ℝ)) n

theorem vonMangoldtWithout_le (R : Set ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    vonMangoldtWithout R n ≤ (vonMangoldt n : ℝ) :=
  Set.indicator_le_self' (fun _ _ => vonMangoldt_nonneg) n

/-- **Removing any prime destroys Weil positivity.**  If `R` contains a prime, then the von Mangoldt
function with the powers of the primes of `R` removed is not full-cone Weil-positive. -/
theorem not_weilPositiveFull_vonMangoldtWithout {R : Set ℕ} {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpR : p ∈ R) :
    ¬ WeilPositiveFull (vonMangoldtWithout R) := by
  intro hW
  have h := eq_vonMangoldt_of_weilPositiveFull_of_le hW fun n _ => vonMangoldtWithout_le R n
  have hp2 := h p hp.two_le
  have hmem : p ∉ {m : ℕ | ¬ ∃ q ∈ R, ∃ k, m = q ^ k} := by
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_not]
    exact ⟨p, hpR, 1, (pow_one p).symm⟩
  have h0 : vonMangoldtWithout R p = 0 := Set.indicator_of_notMem hmem _
  rw [h0, vonMangoldt_apply_prime hp] at hp2
  exact (Real.log_pos (by exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt)).ne' hp2.symm

/-- In particular, the von Mangoldt function of `(1 - 2^{-s}) ζ(s)` (the prime `2` removed) is not
full-cone Weil-positive. -/
theorem not_weilPositiveFull_without_two :
    ¬ WeilPositiveFull (vonMangoldtWithout {2}) :=
  not_weilPositiveFull_vonMangoldtWithout Nat.prime_two rfl
